title: AMC 8 Practice: Counting Triangles in a Hexagon — Hidden Ones
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on counting triangles of every size in a hexagon cut into 24 small triangles, solved with a symmetry shortcut. (Level 5 of 5)
This hexagon is cut into 24 little triangles, but bigger ones are hiding in it too!
Can you find every triangle of every size, pointing up and pointing down?
We count them two ways and then try a big triangle of your own.
